verdict.rationale: AI Gateway is an HTTP API service, so it runs headlessly by design. It offers an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, per-request control headers for caching and logging, and a programmatic patchLog method. Routing rules can be configured via JSON and adjusted from the API without redeploys, and a public OpenAPI spec is available. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, a CLI or infrastructure-as-code workflow for gateway management, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated usage.
